scope: Static diagnosis and minimum proposed evidence fix only

locations.finding: The successful invoke result is local to the retry query. parseStatus/readiness/extra assertion failures throw before observed.value/result assignment, outside the later result-parse try/catch, without attaching actual process evidence or a limited status snapshot.

safeObservationError can preserve process evidence only when the thrown error already has it; it has no sanitized status snapshot. The failed attempt is durably recorded and correctly stops on STATUS_NOT_READY, but the evidence lost by the query cannot be reconstructed here.

minimumFix.queryBoundary: Catch only around invoke/parse/full readiness/all original op assertions. Keep value and parsed status in scope. If invoke returned an actual result, attach its existing processEvidence without changing exit/code/timeouts; attach the bounded snapshot only if JSON parsed. Rethrow the original classified error.
minimumFix.snapshot: Versioned plain literal containing only enum state/backendState/workerState (unknown fallback), releaseMatchesExpected boolean, the 12 fixed component boolean-or-null values, fixed-name missing/invalid lists, and numeric actual/extra component counts. Never store unknown field names, arbitrary reason, URLs, argv, full stdout/stderr, or PII.
minimumFix.outputIntegrity: Use actual process stdoutBytes/stdoutSha256 and stderrBytes/stderrSha256, with the existing safeProcessEvidence filter; never invent a success receipt or native PID.
minimumFix.retrySerializer: safeObservationError additionally serializes only the validated bounded snapshot. Builder and re-sanitizer must preserve the same safe fields idempotently; malformed snapshots are omitted/marked invalid without printing their values.
minimumFix.propagation: Keep the safe snapshot/process through observation-attempt and terminal unknown plus any wrapper sanitizer used by a future explicitly approved caller. Do not overwrite or upgrade old442/295/live modules or existing WAL.

requiredIsolatedNegatives: Successful transport with each of12 components false or absent retains the actual child proof and exact offending fixed key, rejects immediately as NotReady.
State/backend/worker mismatch and release identity mismatch retain bounded summary while keeping original error classifications.
Invalid JSON retains actual byte SHA/process but no fabricated parsed snapshot.
Unknown labels, nested objects, reason/customer fields, extra key names and PII never reach persisted JSON; extra component count remains visible.
Nonzero/timeout/spawn error keeps original underlying process proof without inventing a status body; only original four transient codes can retry up to4 under the same deadline.
Double snapshot/error serialization is idempotent and preserves inner Status PID/output SHA; attempt record is saved before further queries.
No successful receipt or passed status is manufactured from a diagnostic snapshot; old unknown remains untouched.
limitations: This review ran no runtime assertion or production request and does not prove the actual missing21 child exit/PID or exact failing component.
Fixing main is development completion only; the immutable adopted B and old approved batches remain unchanged until separately approved exact adoption.
No retry/execution plan is proposed here.
